name: Authentic Taqueria Carnitas Soft Tacos (Slow-Braised Pork, Cilantro Only)
whyItWorks: Traditional Michoacán carnitas are slow-braised in their own rendered juices with Mexican oregano and salt until melt-in-your-mouth tender. Served on warm soft corn tortillas with fresh cilantro only (avoiding diced raw white onions, salsa verde, and jalapeños). Pure, easily digested fuel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Tacos de Carnitas on soft corn tortillas—con cilantro solamente, SIN cebolla (NO onions), NO salsa, NO jalapeños.' Season with a squeeze of fresh lime and table salt.
